actual_source_reads.title: Queensland Clinical Guidelines — Neonatal resuscitation
actual_source_reads.retrieval_scope: MN22.5-V6-R27 October2022; review October2027. Actual original PDF page24 section5/Table23 ventilation before compressions; page26 section6.2/Table25 epinephrine; page27 section6.3/Table26 indicated fluids or blood. Root read indexed original passages; same QCG group as HIE, shares ANZCOR/ILCOR upstream with AHA. No dose or numeric threshold added.
actual_source_reads.copyright: Queensland2022 original CC BY-NC-ND4.0; source PDF not redistributed or adapted. Original concise factual synthesis and link retained.
